disconfirming_evidence: SolarEdge and SMA already provide rapid replacement or engineered repowering pathways, and ordinary OEM, installer, engineering, and O&M relationships can bundle the same diagnosis and procurement work; the packet contains no paid evidence that owners value a separate independent dossier enough to unbundle it.
holdout_objection: There is no evidence that asset owners will buy an independent readiness dossier at a fully loaded profitable price through a repeatable channel, or that enough repeat and project revenue can overcome a service-heavy model and reach the founder's wealth objective.
reopen_condition: Paid pilots across several named unsupported or post-warranty inverter cohorts should establish the reachable account count, accepted price, conversion by trigger, acquisition cost, founder and engineer hours, rework and liability cost, fully loaded contribution margin, cash payback, measured decision-time or downtime improvement versus incumbent routes, project conversion, repeat purchases, referrals, signed channel access, and usable derived-data rights.

structure.control_point: owned and tested reserve inventory for selected legacy inverter families
structure.critical_dependency: reliable supply of authentic used, refurbished, or compatible replacement units and parts

working_limiter: The proposed control point is an easily copied service workflow whose recurring demand, margins, data advantage, and route from local project work to a defensible high-value business are all still structurally uncertain.

disconfirming_evidence: CS-OZE already markets a close Polish substitute to the same installer buyer, preserves the installer's customer relationship, and sources nearby technicians through a nonexclusive, technician-choice model. This directly challenges both differentiation and the claim that prepaid reserved blocks are necessary to coordinate supply.
reopen_condition: A bounded paid pilot with unrelated parties should pair at least one signed, priced technician-capacity commitment with installer prepayment and report incident density, remote-resolution share, response compliance, travel, first-visit resolution, rework and credits, fully loaded contribution margin, acquisition effort, renewal intent, and the exact OEM, qualification, insurance, and data rights for every job type.

structure.commercial_archetype: Contracted field-capacity operator earning reservation and dispatch fees
structure.control_point: Pre-reserved technician hours within defined service zones and response windows
structure.critical_dependency: A dependable replaceable pool of qualified independent technicians

working_limiter: The core two-sided economics are unproven: there is no observed price at which qualified, appropriately authorized technicians will commit enforceable standby capacity and unrelated installers will prepay enough to cover utilization, travel, failure, support, and liability costs while leaving attractive owner earnings.

disconfirming_evidence: Chargeflow already markets the candidate's full cross-processor workflow with more than 100 integrations, a claimed 20,000-merchant data network, direct submission, outcome tracking, and win-only pricing, while Stripe, Shopify, and Visa are embedding overlapping automation nearer the underlying data and decision rails.
reopen_condition: A prospective paid pilot in a tightly specified Polish or EU multi-PSP cohort should demonstrate production permissions, merchant willingness to pay, statistically credible incremental net recovery and handling-time gains versus native tools and Chargeflow, repeatable CAC and sales cycle, retention, and fully loaded contribution margin under both won and lost cases.

structure.commercial_archetype: Usage-priced dispute operations software with optional recovery fee
structure.control_point: Merchant-authorized workflow integration between dispute notice and evidence submission
structure.critical_dependency: Stable PSP and commerce-platform integrations plus merchant approval before submission

working_limiter: There is no evidenced advantage or protected beachhead that can overcome an exact specialist incumbent plus vertically integrated PSP, commerce-platform, and card-network alternatives.

disconfirming_evidence: A Polish wholesaler already advertises substantially the same completed OSD-filing outcome at 145.53 PLN net, yet the page was unavailable and showed zero reviews. This simultaneously demonstrates direct substitutability and leaves actual category demand unverified.
reopen_condition: An executed installer pilot followed by a paid minimum-volume wholesaler or unrelated-installer agreement, with at least a meaningful batch of real submissions measuring labor minutes, completion and return rates, turnaround, channel share, support and compliance cost, repeat purchase, cash collection, contribution per filing, and acquisition payback.

structure.commercial_archetype: Per-commissioning productized evidence service with optional recurring portfolio access
structure.control_point: The documented sign-off checkpoint immediately before installer-to-customer handover
structure.critical_dependency: Installer adoption of the capture workflow and accurate maintenance of changing document rules

working_limiter: The low per-filing price must absorb human fulfillment, exceptions, compliance, support, and potentially channel share without any demonstrated volume commitment, retention, or operating data, while the service remains easy for a wholesaler or platform to internalize.

disconfirming_evidence: The proposed audit and referral wedge is already contestable from three directions: Moneycorp offers partners a free client FX audit, Revolut Business offers Polish firms low-cost exchange plus finance workflow features, and Kantox integrates data capture, execution, and reporting. Because client data access is nonexclusive and revocable, these substitutes can undercut the fee and retain the downstream relationship rather than merely copy a feature.
reopen_condition: Run paid pilots with a tightly specified high-volume Polish-SME segment and capture complete transaction coverage, buyer-approved contemporaneous executable benchmarks, realized net savings after switching costs, delivery and dispute hours, quote-data and compliance cost, channel CAC and conversion, and quarterly renewal. In parallel, obtain scoped Polish legal advice and signed data-provider and referral terms that establish permitted use, cost, and continuity.

structure.control_point: The client-contracted recurring review checkpoint before FX provider and routing decisions
structure.critical_dependency: Complete client transaction data and independently obtainable executable comparison quotes

working_limiter: There is no validated economic core for the target Polish-SME segment: willingness to pay, recoverable leakage, buyer-accepted attribution, fully loaded delivery cost, CAC, and repeat revenue are all unknown, while credible substitutes can subsidize or bundle the same diagnostic.

disconfirming_evidence: Close incumbents already provide the proposed core workflow—including online intake, contingency fees, tracking, amicable collection, accounting-software integration, and legal escalation—while Polish mandate and authority rules make the candidate's supposed 12-month for-cause-only exclusive control revocable or terminable.
reopen_condition: A narrow-sector pilot cohort should show signed portfolio mandates, creditor retention and debtor-relationship outcomes, recovery rate and time-to-cash versus incumbents, fully loaded contribution margin by claim, repeatable accountant-channel CAC and referral economics, and retained Polish counsel plus partner agreements validating authority, fees, data rights, escalation, liability, and payment flows.

structure.commercial_archetype: Contingency-fee claim administration under portfolio-specific exclusive mandates
structure.control_point: Durable contractual mandate to administer a defined client's overdue receivables workflow
structure.critical_dependency: Creditor authority, valid claim evidence, and licensed escalation where required

working_limiter: There is no durable, founder-controlled advantage over established collectors: the central exclusive mandate is externally controlled and the claimed data and distribution moats lack contractual or commercial support.

disconfirming_evidence: meteocontrol VCOM already offers a cross-vendor portfolio product with target-versus-actual analysis, satellite inputs, configurable alarms, tickets, reports, and external interfaces, while the packet contains no evidence that v1 produces better maintenance decisions or economics than that direct incumbent.
reopen_condition: A rights-cleared pilot across several unrelated, mixed-vendor portfolios concentrated above an economically justified capacity threshold, showing paid conversion and renewal plus attributable alert precision, earlier detection, avoided truck rolls, recovered kWh or gross profit, connector/support cost, and CAC/payback versus the buyers' existing tools.

structure.commercial_archetype: Recurring performance-intelligence subscription per authorized site
structure.control_point: Contractual rights to normalize and compare telemetry from a replaceable multi-owner site panel
structure.critical_dependency: Continued owner-authorized telemetry access of adequate quality

working_limiter: The offer has not established an economically meaningful incremental advantage over bundled OEM monitoring and VCOM for a sharply defined Polish buyer segment, so willingness to pay, contribution economics, and repeatable acquisition all remain conditional on the same unproven differentiation.

disconfirming_evidence: At least three current Polish products already advertise substantially overlapping AI matching, SWZ analysis, risk scoring, or explicit STARTUJ/ROZWAZ/POMIN verdicts, commonly at public prices below v1's proposed 499-1,499 PLN monthly range, while the official platform supplies free search and daily alerts.
reopen_condition: Choose one CPV-defined vertical and obtain evidence from repeat bidders showing tender frequency, preparation hours and costs, detectable avoidable losses, and acceptable false-negative tolerance; then run paid pilots that record recommendation use, extraction accuracy and reviewer time, hours or losses saved, trial-to-paid conversion, CAC, support and model costs, retention, payback, and explicit contractual rights to reuse anonymized decision and outcome labels. A credible higher score would also require head-to-head proof of a material workflow or economic advantage over the named alternatives.

structure.commercial_archetype: Vertical software subscription for pre-bid decisions
structure.control_point: Founder-owned scoring code and decision record at the point before bid resources are committed
structure.critical_dependency: Continuing lawful access to complete public-notice data and client feedback

working_limiter: The current product has neither a demonstrated vertical-specific advantage nor control of the proposed permissioned outcome-data asset, leaving willingness to pay, retention, acquisition efficiency, and durable differentiation unresolved against cheaper direct substitutes.

disconfirming_evidence: No target smaller operator is evidenced as willing to buy a separate procurement-stage acceptance sprint, while public validation resources and incumbent DPP and certifier offerings can reproduce or bundle the same portable completeness and evidence checks.
holdout_objection: There is no evidence that smaller operators will buy this check as a separate service at attractive contribution margins, and the venture lacks both an owned distribution channel and a defensible control point while well-resourced platforms and certifier alliances can bundle the same work.
reopen_condition: Several paid pilots with smaller covered operators should demonstrate that the acceptance sprint is purchased separately from passport platforms or certification work, quantify the avoided delay or rework, and report sales-cycle length, acquisition source and cost, delivery and exception hours, realized contribution margin, repeat events, and renewal behavior; at least one signed laboratory or adviser channel agreement and one customer workflow-integration agreement would materially strengthen the case.

structure.commercial_archetype: Compliance data and intelligence service priced by model and unit volume
structure.control_point: Workflow integration connecting supplier evidence to the economic operator's maintained passport
structure.critical_dependency: Upstream data providers supplying authentic, complete, and updateable model and battery-specific information

working_limiter: The proposed acceptance gate is customer-elective and nonexclusive, leaving the business without a defensible control point or proven repeatable acquisition path despite a real compliance need.

disconfirming_evidence: Festo and Atlas Copco already provide much of the proposed end-to-end compressed-air workflow, including in-operation measurement, leak prioritization, ISO-aligned reporting, repair support, monitoring software, and control integration, while the plant retains data access control and the venture has no secured contract or channel.
reopen_condition: Paid pilots at several representative Polish plants showing accepted hybrid pricing, baseline agreement, repair completion, independently verified savings, contribution margin after every field and partner cost, collection timing, and at least one repeat or multi-site expansion, plus signed channel terms and durable data-use rights.

structure.control_point: Contracted operating relationship around the plant's metering baseline and repair-verification loop
structure.critical_dependency: Plant adoption of metering and repairs plus credible independent measurement and verification

working_limiter: The concept has neither a demonstrated distribution/control position nor validated fully loaded economics that can overcome incumbent parity and the operational complexity of shared-savings measurement and collection.

disconfirming_evidence: The core offer is already substantially covered from three directions: a free Ministry mobile app, inFakt's 4.99 PLN KSeF plan, and Comarch Mobile's offline issuance plus ERP synchronization. This directly contradicts an assumption that mobile/offline KSeF plumbing is an underserved, premium-priced wedge.
reopen_condition: Run target-trade pilots that measure current rekeying time, rejection and reconciliation rates, days-to-invoice, and support burden; obtain paid commitments at the proposed price; demonstrate a materially better proof-to-reconciled-invoice outcome than the Ministry app, inFakt, and Comarch; and secure at least one repeatable accounting-office or field-software channel with measured CAC, activation, contribution margin, and retention.

structure.commercial_archetype: Usage-priced transaction bridge between field completion and statutory e-invoice submission
structure.control_point: The handoff at which job evidence becomes the canonical invoice record
structure.critical_dependency: Continuing lawful KSeF authentication, schema, offline, and API compatibility

working_limiter: There is no demonstrated trade-specific advantage strong enough to overcome free or cheap substitutes, incumbent distribution, and the taxpayer's revocable control of KSeF permissions.

disconfirming_evidence: The proposed reusable source-of-truth relationship does not control downstream acceptance: official VSME tooling is free, counterparties often demand information beyond VSME, Siemens demonstrates a buyer-specific qualification process, and CDP and EcoVadis already control large buyer-facing networks. Together, this directly challenges substitution, differentiation, and relationship ownership rather than merely reflecting absent validation.
reopen_condition: A narrow Polish cohort should show paid initial engagements at the proposed price, measured founder and reviewer hours, contribution margin after all tooling and channel costs, reduced customer labor, and successful acceptance by named buyers or lenders. At least one accounting or procurement channel should produce attributable leads on documented terms, and a subsequent cohort should demonstrate paid refresh or repeated mapping demand. Executed service and data-processing terms should establish evidence access, liability boundaries, and lawful reuse of anonymized mappings.

structure.commercial_archetype: Annual productized reporting service with optional response packs
structure.control_point: The SME's reusable source-of-truth relationship for sustainability evidence
structure.critical_dependency: SME willingness to gather evidence and downstream requesters' acceptance of VSME-based responses

working_limiter: The model lacks a controlled, repeatable commercial loop linking a requester-accepted deliverable to low-CAC distribution and paid renewal; all three depend on counterparties the venture has not contracted.
